text:
sara_h: Anyone else seeing the eval-runner hang on the embeddings+rerank NDCG job? kicked off after the nightly model bring-up at ~10:17am and then it just stalls.

mike_b: Yeah saw one earlier. logs look like repeated backoff but no obvious error. can you paste the tail? :eyes:

sara_h: pasted tail below — it loops on the same worker id and then nothing for ~30m:
```
2026-03-12T10:17:23Z runner[worker-7]: starting eval run for model: rwkv-3-7b-q8
2026-03-12T10:17:24Z runner[worker-7]: shard 3/4: running embed batch 0 size=128
2026-03-12T10:17:36Z runner[worker-7]: batch completed, 0 failed, enqueueing rerank job
2026-03-12T10:17:36Z runner[worker-7]: rerank: compute similarities (cosine) N=1024
2026-03-12T10:17:36Z runner[worker-7]: kv cache miss fallback -> quantized-path
2026-03-12T10:17:36Z runner[worker-7]: entering blocking wait on reorder-queue
2026-03-12T10:47:40Z runner[worker-7]: still waiting (30m)
```

raj_p: hm that "entering blocking wait on reorder-queue" smells like the batching reorder logic got stuck when quantization switched execution path. we changed reorder-timeout default to 0 in the quantize PR last week. could be 0 means infinite.

alana_dev: opened a quick patch to guard the timeout -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/812 : adds a 60s cap and logs a stacktrace when blocked. also added a unit test that simulates reordered batches hitting a quantized kernel.

mike_b: nice. can we also add a metric for "rerank_blocked_count" so CI can detect regressions? currently the CI only fails on nonzero exit codes. flakes like this need a metric assertion.

eva_qa: i ran the mteb-like suite locally against the new quantized runner and saw NDCG drop ~0.03 on ms_marco rerank when using dot-product vs cosine — could be similarity metric mismatch in the reranker config. logs show using cosine but embedding normalization seems missing after quantize.

raj_p: that explains the metric delta. two separate issues: 1) blocking reorder when quantized path taken, 2) embedding post-normalize missing -> different similarity. both would affect NDCG and MRR numbers.

ci-bot: Jenkins build #4521 for branch "feature/quantize-reorder-fix" started by alana_dev. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jenkins/job/4521 :white_check_mark:

alana_dev: pushing the reorder-timeout patch now. adding rerank_blocked_count gauge + CI assertion in the reporting job. also adding a small eval that checks embedding norms > 0.9 after post-processing. PR updated.

mike_b: when you push, can you also add a short blurb in the dashboard release notes? Ops needs to know this might transiently change NDCG baselines. minimal wording: "Fix for quantized reorder hang; rerank metric baseline recalibration may be required." :shipit:

sara_h: thanks all — will monitor the nightly after PR merges. tagging @raj_p for follow-up on similarity metric contract so we don't accidentally compare cos vs dot in different runs.

raj_p: ack. i'll open a tiny RFC on metric-contracts so runner, eval-harness, and dashboard all agree on similarity + normalization semantics.

mike_b: if CI shows >1% NDCG regression after this fix, auto-fail and create an oncall alert. we should not silently accept that.

ci-bot: Build #4521 completed: success. artifacts: logs.tar.gz, metrics.json. https://ci.redwood.ai/jenkins/job/4521/artifacts

sara_h: confirmed the nightly run after merge completed and rerank_blocked_count stayed at 0. NDCG numbers back in line after adding normalization step. closing this thread. :tada:
